prompt: The first-person perspective begins with a steady forward movement along a snow-covered trail under a night sky, illuminated faintly by ambient light that casts soft shadows across the terrain. As the viewer progresses, the camera captures the gentle descent and ascent over undulating mounds of snow, with occasional specks of falling snowflakes adding a dynamic texture to the scene. The surrounding environment is shrouded in darkness, punctuated by the subtle glow reflecting off the snow, enhancing the contours of the landscape. The camera angle remains consistently at eye level, providing an immersive experience of navigating through the wintry expanse. Midway through the journey, the path reveals a metal railing on the left, guiding the way past rocky outcrops partially buried in snow. The viewer continues along this narrow, winding trail, the camera subtly panning to capture the rugged textures of the rocks and the smooth, untouched snow. The atmosphere is serene and isolated, with no other figures or sounds disrupting the quiet solitude of the Mardi Himal Trail. As the journey progresses, the camera maintains its steady pace, offering a continuous and unobstructed view of the snowy, nocturnal landscape, emphasizing the vastness and tranquility of the natural setting.
